method: One EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS execution immediately after each normal query; cache may be warm. No benchmark or production latency claim.

cases.name: ranked
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND ("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $2

cases.name: countless
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND ("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $2

cases.name: offset
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND ("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $2 OFFSET $3

cases.name: keyset
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND ("tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $1) AND (("tinkick_test_documents"."id" > $2)) ORDER BY "tinkick_test_documents"."id" ASC LIMIT $3

results.title: An expedition journal with a lighting note

cases.name: multiple_fields
cases.sql: SELECT "tinkick_test_documents".*, tin.full_score("tinkick_test_documents".ctid) AS _tinkick_score FROM "tinkick_test_documents" WHERE (TRUE) AND ("tinkick_test_documents"."title" ==> $1 OR "tinkick_test_documents"."body" ==> $2) ORDER BY _tinkick_score DESC LIMIT $3

cases.name: keyset_match_all
